chapter: Callers: Papa John Joseph to Congo Square
title: Why Johnny Hyman became Johnny Wiggs
summary: Wiggs explains he took a stage name from his middle name Wiginton to protect his school teaching job when he began radio work.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: We're going to go on to the next line because lots more people want to talk with you two gentlemen. Good morning. You're on the air with Johnny Wiggs and Dick Allen. This is Donnell Call. Could you please tell me if Johnny Wiggs is the same person as Johnny Hyman?

Right. Why did he change his name? Well, I'd like to air this very much. I was working in a local high school teaching quietly mechanical drawing, and I got a job on WSMB, one of the local radio stations, playing this bawdy, horrible thing called jazz. And I knew that I would never be permitted by my higher-ups to continue working for the school board and play this horrible music. So I had to take the first half of my middle name, which is Wiginton, and use that as a name, Johnny Wiggs. Period.
Okay, and we thank you for calling.
